tasks.instruction: Implement opt-in --sort-url for rss-compare: sort URL rows inside each original membership/status group for JSON/CSV/Markdown, deterministic if capture input row permutations only. Leave default outputs byte-identical and keep summary counts, duplicate, metadata, safety, caveat and attention semantics. Tests provider-free.

Implement opt-in --show-retitles for rss-compare: when enabled JSON includes retitled_urls [{url,older_title,newer_title}] for the exact same saved URL with changed title, and Markdown includes escaped old/new retitle comparison table. CSV unchanged, default output byte-identical, no inference of publisher edits or other changed semantics. Tests provider-free.
